brand.name: Reminiscence Therapy Suite
brand.tagline: Familiar places, objects, photographs and sounds, explored together at your own pace.

disclaimer: An activity space for looking at familiar places, objects, photographs and sounds together. It is not a medical treatment and does not assess memory or health.
privacy: Everything you add stays in this browser on this device. Nothing is uploaded. Clearing this browser's data removes it.
